query:

[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Soo-Yeon, group-interaction, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Group decides to play Mysterium as the next game, with Soo-Yeon proposing it and others agreeing.
agent_answer:
**A. Soo-Yeon**

Soo-Yeon’s response revealed that she was actually **not in favor of pizza** for that meal; she preferred something lighter. She did not directly object to the group’s pizza decision, but her wording signals her real position indirectly:

> “Priya mentioned pizza for tonight. Can we do something lighter? I had a heavy lunch 😅”

The key signal is that she **framed her disagreement as a polite question** (“Can we do something lighter?”) and gave a **personal reason** (“I had a heavy lunch”) rather than saying “No pizza” or explicitly rejecting the group’s choice. That shows her non-objection was not agreement — she was steering the group toward a lighter alternative without confronting the pizza decision head-on.

query:
The group discussed the expectation that everyone should bring either a game or food to the annual marathon. What did Nadia's response signal about her actual relationship to this group norm, and how would you know from what she said?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Tomasz
C. Marcus
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:06:00) I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.
[2] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:04:00) In my experience the marathon only works when everyone contributes. It is the social contract of a shared day.
[3] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:07:00) that totally counts Nadia! honestly a good game pitch is worth more than another bag of chips 😊
[4] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:10:00) so basically that explains why Nadia didn't push back on Tomasz's Dune ruling even though everyone else was complaining tbh
[5] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:38:00) I did not want to interrupt the game.
[6] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Explains she did not want to interrupt the game, hence not mentioning the food issue.
[7] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Will bring a game to the marathon but does not participate in food arrangement.
[8] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Thanks Soo-Yeon for flagging the food issue, noting she noticed it as well but did not say anything.
[9] (about=Nadia, said_by=Lena, profile, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Lena suggests that Nadia's lack of pushback on Tomasz's Dune ruling is explained by their shared wargame history.
[10] (about=Nadia, core, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Does not eat during sessions and will not join the pizza order.
[11] (about=Nadia, core, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Will set up the bird tray for Wingspan and asks everyone to keep food away from the card area.
agent_answer:
**A. Nadia**

Nadia signaled that she accepts the group norm only partly: she will contribute by bringing a **game**, but she explicitly refuses the **food arrangement**. Her exact words were:

> “I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.”

This shows she is not rejecting the marathon contribution expectation altogether—she meets it through the game—but she draws a clear boundary around food. The memory reinforces this: she does not eat during sessions, will not join the pizza order, and asks everyone to keep food away from the card area.
